TestCase_Description: Verify default reset value of gp0_gpio_8 register field data_in after hardware reset. Read the register and confirm bit 0 matches expected default with bit 0 masked out.
Pre_Conditions: Hardware reset (hreset_n) must be asserted prior to test. GPIO block must be accessible via AHB bus.
Test_Steps: 1. Apply hardware reset to GPIO block. 2. Read gp0_gpio_8 register. 3. Mask bit 0 of read value. 4. Compare against expected default value.
Expected_Result: Read value (masked) matches expected default value for data_in field.
Notes: Bit 0 (data_in) is masked during comparison as pin level may float if not externally driven.

TestCase_Description: Write/Read verification of gp0_gpio_8 register using six test patterns (0xFFFFFFFF 0xAAAAAAAA 0x55555555 0xF5F5F5F5 0xA5A5A5A5 0xFFFF0000). Write each pattern masked with write_mask and read back masked with read_mask. Verify read value matches expected computed value.
Pre_Conditions: Hardware reset applied. Register not in skip_array.
Test_Steps: 1. Write pattern masked with write mask to gp0_gpio_8. 2. Read back register masked with read mask. 3. Compute expected value from write mask and read mask and default value. 4. Compare read value with expected. 5. Repeat for all six patterns.
Expected_Result: Read-back value matches expected for all six patterns.
Pass_Criteria: (read_reg(addr) & read_mask) == ((pattern & read_mask & write_mask) | (~write_mask & read_mask & default_val)); wr_fail_cnt == 0
Notes: Six patterns tested: 0xFFFFFFFF 0xAAAAAAAA 0x55555555 0xF5F5F5F5 0xA5A5A5A5 0xFFFF0000. RO fields (data_in intr_raw_sts) retain default. WO field (intr_clr) skipped.

TestCase_Description: Verify that VRRW-type registers (gpio_intr_raw_stclr1 at offset 0x80 and group io_ctrl/dout/din registers at offsets 0x94-0xC0) are correctly skipped during write/read testing as defined in skip_array and skip_rst_array.

Expected_Result: VRRW registers are not written during write/read test. Group din registers are not checked during default value verification.
Pass_Criteria: No write/read operations attempted on skipped registers; no false failures reported

TestCase_Description: Verify GPIO level-sensitive interrupt generation with active-high level selection. For each GPIO pin 8-39 configure input mode with level_sel=1 (active high) and pedge_intr_en=1 then enable group interrupt and trigger via SRAM write. Verify interrupt is received via GIC IRQ 87 and ISR validates raw status and group status.
Pre_Conditions: Hardware reset applied. GIC IRQ 87 enabled for GPIO0. LSS sysreg interrupt enabled for GPIO0.
Test_Steps: 1. Enable GIC IRQ 87 for GPIO0 interrupt routing. 2. Enable LSS sysreg interrupt for GPIO0. 3. For each GPIO pin 8-39 write 0x00180000 to configure input mode with level_sel=1. 4. Enable group interrupt for the pin in gp0_intr1_intr_en1. 5. Write trigger value to SRAM location. 6. Wait for ISR to fire. 7. In ISR verify intr_raw_sts bit is set. 8. Verify group interrupt status in gp0_intr1_intr_sts1. 9. Clear interrupt by writing to intr_clr. 10. Verify interrupt cleared successfully. 11. Disable group interrupt. 12. Clear LSS sysreg raw status. 13. Clear GIC IRQ.
Expected_Result: Interrupt fires for each GPIO pin. ISR confirms raw status bit set and group status bit set. Interrupt clears successfully. Sysreg status clears.
Pass_Criteria: test_err == 0; intr_raw_sts bit == 1 in ISR; group intr_sts bit matches pin; post-clear read == 0x100001; sysreg cleared
Notes: Active-high level interrupt test. 0x00180000 = io_ctrl=1 (input) + level_sel=1 + pedge_intr_en=1. Iterates GPIO pins 8-39.

TestCase_Description: Verify GPIO level-sensitive interrupt generation with active-low level selection. For each GPIO pin 8-39 configure input mode with level_sel=0 (active low) then enable group interrupt and trigger via SRAM write with inverted pattern. Verify interrupt is received via GIC IRQ 87.
Pre_Conditions: Hardware reset applied. GIC IRQ 87 enabled. LSS sysreg interrupt enabled.
Test_Steps: 1. For each GPIO pin 8-39 write 0x00100000 to configure input mode with level_sel=0. 2. Enable group interrupt for the pin. 3. Write inverted trigger value (~(1<<i)) to SRAM location. 4. Wait for ISR to fire. 5. In ISR verify raw status and group status. 6. Clear interrupt and verify. 7. Clear sysreg status.
Expected_Result: Interrupt fires for each GPIO pin with active-low level. ISR confirms raw status and group status. Interrupt clears successfully.
Pass_Criteria: test_err == 0; intr_raw_sts bit == 1; group status matches; post-clear verified; sysreg cleared
Notes: Active-low level interrupt test. 0x00100000 = io_ctrl=1 (input) + level_sel=0. Trigger uses inverted bit pattern.

TestCase_Description: Verify interrupt clear mechanism in gp0_gpio_8 through gp0_gpio_39. After interrupt is raised write 0x00110000 (intr_clr=1 + io_ctrl=1) and verify post-clear read returns 0x100001.
Pre_Conditions: Interrupt must be active (raw status set) before clear operation.
Test_Steps: 1. Trigger an interrupt on the GPIO pin. 2. Write 0x00110000 to the GPIO register to set intr_clr bit. 3. Wait for clear to propagate. 4. Read back the register. 5. Verify read value equals 0x100001 (io_ctrl=1 and data_in=1).
Expected_Result: Post-clear register read returns 0x100001 confirming interrupt cleared and io_ctrl retained.
Notes: Interrupt clear writes 1 to bit 16. Post-clear expected value 0x100001 = bit 20 (io_ctrl=1) + bit 0 (data_in=1).

TestCase_Description: Verify group interrupt enable and status mechanism via gp0_intr1_intr_en1 and gp0_intr1_intr_sts1 registers. Enable interrupt for specific GPIO pin and verify masked status reflects the correct pin.
Field_Name: G8_intr_en through G39_intr_en; G8_intr_sts through G39_intr_sts
Pre_Conditions: GPIO interrupt must be triggered. GIC and sysreg interrupts enabled.
Test_Steps: 1. Write (1<<i) to gp0_intr1_intr_en1 to enable interrupt for GPIO pin i. 2. Trigger interrupt. 3. In ISR read gp0_intr1_intr_sts1. 4. Verify bit i is set in status register. 5. Disable interrupt by writing 0x00000000 to gp0_intr1_intr_en1. 6. Read status register and verify it returns 0.
Expected_Result: Group interrupt status bit matches enabled GPIO pin. After disable status reads 0.
Pass_Criteria: (rdata_grp & (1<<i)) != 0 during ISR; rdata_grp == 0 after disable; test_err == 0
Notes: Interrupt enable register at offset 0x84. Status register at offset 0x88. Both are 32-bit with per-GPIO-pin bits.

TestCase_Description: Verify LSS sysreg interrupt raw status clear mechanism. After GPIO interrupt is serviced write the GPIO0 interrupt bit to the sysreg raw status/clear register and verify the bit is cleared.
Register_Name: LSS sysreg raw_stcr1; LSS sysreg intr_en1
Pre_Conditions: GPIO interrupt must have been raised and GIC ISR entered. LSS sysreg interrupt enabled.
Test_Steps: 1. In ISR after GPIO interrupt processing write GPIO0 interrupt bit to LSS sysreg raw status/clear register. 2. Read back the register. 3. Verify GPIO0 interrupt bit is cleared (ANDed with mask == 0).
Expected_Result: LSS sysreg raw status bit for GPIO0 is cleared after write.
Notes: LSS sysreg registers are outside GPIO IP but required for interrupt routing. Conditional on #ifdef GPIO0.

TestCase_Description: Verify GIC IRQ 87 routing for GPIO0 interrupt. Enable GIC IRQ 87 and confirm interrupt is received in Default_IRQHandler when GPIO level interrupt is triggered.
Pre_Conditions: GIC must be initialized. GPIO0 macro must be defined.
Test_Steps: 1. Call GIC_EnableIRQ(87) to enable GPIO0 interrupt at GIC level. 2. Trigger GPIO level interrupt. 3. Verify Default_IRQHandler is entered. 4. After ISR processing call GIC_ClearIRQ(87).
Expected_Result: ISR (Default_IRQHandler) is invoked upon GPIO interrupt. GIC IRQ cleared successfully.
Pass_Criteria: int_pend transitions from 1 to 0 indicating ISR executed; GIC_ClearIRQ(87) called without error
Notes: GIC IRQ 87 is mapped to GPIO0 interrupt. Conditional on #ifdef GPIO0. int_pend flag used for ISR synchronization.

TestCase_Description: Verify SRAM trigger mechanism at address 0xA0243ffc used to stimulate GPIO pin level for interrupt generation. Write 0xFFFFFFFF for active-high test and inverted pattern for active-low test.
Pre_Conditions: SRAM location 0xA0243ffc must be accessible. GPIO configured in input mode.
Test_Steps: 1. Write 0xFFFFFFFF to SRAM address 0xA0243ffc for active-high level test. 2. Write ~(1<<i) to SRAM address for active-low level test. 3. Verify GPIO pin level changes trigger the expected interrupt.
Expected_Result: SRAM write successfully stimulates GPIO pin level causing interrupt generation.
Pass_Criteria: Interrupt fires after SRAM write; int_pend transitions to 0
Notes: Hardcoded SRAM address used as GPIO pin stimulus. 0xA0243ffc is outside GPIO register space.
